integrity.first_public_date_basis: The arXiv record for 0809.4966 lists version 1 on 2008-09-29.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The archival source lists primary MSC 14N35.
integrity.proof_basis: The full archival text gives the common t-strict Schubert indexing, the type B/type C class scaling, and the special Chern-class normalization used to identify the Pluecker divisor.
integrity.verification_basis: The bundled checker independently verifies only the ambient specialization through Weyl products; the Schubert-wide theorem is proved symbolically.

scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to nonmaximal isotropic Grassmannians with r<n.
It compares the standard corresponding Schubert varieties and their Pluecker degrees, not arbitrary subvarieties or alternative embeddings.
The conclusion is a short geometric consequence of a known type B/type C cohomology-ring scaling, so an unindexed older source may contain the same degree statement.
title: A dyadic degree dictionary for nonmaximal type B and C Schubert varieties
